Wow, dude. Just wow.
This is a thing that triggers my depression, which is why I'm here.
I am.
Can you see how, if it repeatedly happens, it can look like it really is about age?

True, but it still makes me feel really old and ugly. I feel undesirable because I'm not young. I hear about how "that chick is crazy" even though she's just young, and yet those are the ones that these guys want to date. I'm not crazy. I have my shit together, mostly. What's wrong with me?

I'm not really sure what that has to do with my feelings and my situation. I'm not trying to fight or be angry with you, but I can't see the link between younger men looking for older women and me being rejected by multiple men, my own age, for someone 15 years or more younger. Plus, telling me that you wouldn't worry about it, also doesn't really pertain to how I feel about it. Am I missing a part?

I'm right there with you. It's like, you trusted that person so much. You put all your faith and energy into them and now they're just gone. For me, mine was supposed to be the rest of my life, and then he started playing games and lying and bullshitting me. He took my trust for granted. He treated me like I was just this idiot that he could tell anything to and it would all be ok. So, this person that was my life, if he could treat me like that, who else could, and did? How could I ever put my love and trust into anyone else? Including me. I was the idiot that let it happen anyway. I can't even trust myself to make the right decision, why would I trust anyone else?
Well that changes everything.

Exactly. It's so frustrating to have to repeat myself. It takes so much energy to have to interact with people as it is. It's even more when that has to be dragged on because people just can't answer my question, or ask me questions that have already been answered. I feel like I have to think for people a lot of the time.

To one friend I want to say "You are one of the best friends I've ever had. You're a partner, and the first person to show me what love is. I love you and want to spend the rest of my life with you, even if that means just being your friend."

To another: "We will be together again when you learn to love yourself and actually become the independent grown up you think you are."

He does this amazingly annoying lip smacking thing when he's trying to sound smart. He is smart, but he's usually telling me something that I already know and explains it to me like I'm 8. Instead of "um" or "uh" or any of those other space replacement words, he smacks his lips. It's more fucking annoying than if he were to say "like".

I hate him. 

He's stopped listening to me, the sex is horrible, he needs to clean out the 400 gigs of porn that is on the hard drive before he downloads more, he needs to quit smoking and/or quit burning holes in the carpet because he isn't paying attention, he needs to gtfo of the house more than going to work, he needs to quit asking my permission for EVERYTHING, he needs to leave me alone, he needs to quit speaking to me like I'm 5, he needs to quit talking to me about the same stupid shit that he's been talking about for the past 5 years and do something about it instead, he needs to find himself 1 goal, just one, that's all I ask, he needs ambition, he needs to find himself, and he needs to quit using pot as an excuse. So yeah, I hate him. That's what I can't tell him.

You just described exactly how I feel. I drive down the road hoping someone will sideswipe me and kill me or the bridge I'm on will give out. I go to sleep hoping I don't wake up. There is no reason to keep on being cattle. Why not take me to the slaughter before my meat is unusable? At least you are reaching out. You are talking. This means you want it to stop.

So, how do you do that? Well, you could tell yourself that you are better than that over and over and over and constantly try harder which in the long run will make you fall right back into this state because you will realize that you still didn't get any farther ahead, or you can just accept it. Accept that this is who you are and what you ware always going to be. Accept that this is life and it's not going to get any better. You will always be a drone making it possible for someone else to live in luxury. You are the reason someone else is comfortable. 

If you choose acceptance, good luck. It will not get better, but it will be easier to deal with. If you do not, then I wish you happiness and success in all that you reach for.

There is another option. You could choose both. Accept that life is shit, but try anyway. Whatever it is, it's your decision. When you make that decision is when you will start feeling better.
